description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 014 are a round jali window: the product photo shows a circular terracotta jali set into a wooden interior wall, suited to living rooms, stairwells, prayer rooms and any inside wall that needs a decorative opening.

## How it looks
The circle frames the jali pattern like a porthole, and the warm terracotta stands out against the wood panelling around it. A round opening draws the eye more than a square one, so it tends to work as a single focal point rather than repeated along a wall. Light passing through the jali throws a soft pattern on the floor and walls.

## Where it works
- **Jali for interior wall** between a lounge and a dining area, keeping the rooms connected.
- **Circular jali design** above a staircase or at a landing to bring light into a dark corner.
- **Decorative wall opening** in a prayer room or entrance, where a calm, traditional detail suits the space.

Terracotta brings the look of traditional Mughal-era screens indoors, and clay is generally stable in heat, so it suits Pakistani homes where wood and clay are often combined.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Design: circular jali set into a wooden interior wall (from the product photo)
- Material colour, block size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you order.

Ask your carpenter or mason to plan the round frame before the wall is finished, so the opening is cut true. Indoors, dust with a soft dry brush and wipe with a damp cloth.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm, or ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with the opening diameter for a dated quote. See the [fine lattice jali panel](/products/terracotta-jali-tiles-011), the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide) or the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of a round jali window?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the diameter, the design and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can a terracotta jali be used indoors?
faqs.a: Yes. Indoors it works as a decorative opening or partition between rooms; it only needs a proper frame and an occasional dusting.

faqs.q: Round jali window or square jali panel: which suits my room?
faqs.a: A round jali works best as one focal point, such as above stairs or in a prayer room; square panels repeat more easily along a long wall or as a partition.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 014" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
